feature_manifest.json.history_indicator: HistoryIndicator preserves native NaNs and appends fire-history censor indicator before coordinates
feature_manifest.json.density_formula: Sum native integer flash counts first; W=A*(1e6/native_cell_area_m2) columnwise; density=W@window_counts. A=intersection_area/target_area, not count redistribution.
feature_manifest.json.timing: Issue 00:00 America/Toronto; last complete bin ends 03:00 UTC, one hour before issue in May--October; trailing 8/56 complete 3-hour bins, not local calendar days
feature_manifest.json.quality: Positive-weight contributors with any explicit fill/NaN make target-window NaN; observed zeros remain zero. No per-bin outage flags; quiet weather is not masked. Approximate native-grid density, not exact located flashes.
feature_manifest.json.availability: Retrospective source product; no operational availability or performance claim

feature_audit.json.projection: A_ij=intersection_area/target_area; W_ij=A_ij*1e6/native_cell_area_m2; W @ integer native window sums
feature_audit.json.missing_rule: Any explicit fill/NaN in any contributing positive-weight native cell/bin makes the window unknown (NaN).
source_caveats: Approximate native-grid density, not exact located target-cell flash counts.
Zeros are observed detector zeros; undocumented historical outages cannot be identified.
Retrospective source publication latency is unknown; no per-bin detector outage flags exist.
Trailing complete 3-hour bins are not exact previous local calendar days.
Native cell bounds are inferred as centres +/-0.05 degrees; audited intersections omit areas below 1 m2.

daily_budget_results.json.scope: Global daily budgets, identical cells/day and label-blind grid_id ties; no operating policy selected

quiet_period_sensitivity.json.method: Same five fitted models, validation inputs only: replace just the lightning columns whose windows overlap >=24h entire-domain quiet runs with NaN. Keep every row; no refit; not an estimate of outages or a test of training-contamination effects.

lightning_coverage_audit/configuration.j.window_rule: Last 8 or 56 complete consecutive 3h bins ending before local issue time; not exact previous local calendar days
lightning_coverage_audit/configuration.j.validity_rule: Every source cell intersecting target by >=1m2 must have valid count in every expected bin; geometry full within 1e-6 relative area
lightning_coverage_audit/configuration.j.zero_rule: Valid zero means zero DETECTED CG flashes in source support; no inference about undocumented outages

spatial_mapping.method: Positive-area intersections of full 10km EPSG:3978 squares with 0.1deg geographic source cells; source edges densified at 0.025deg
spatial_mapping.coordinate_bounds: Regular lat/lon centres +/-0.05deg; source does not supply spatial coordinate bounds

lightning_coverage_audit/configuration.j.scope: All-year source coverage audit only; no label access

lightning_coverage_audit/download_manife.scope: Source coverage audit only; no model fitting, no existing feature dataset writes, no commits
